headline: Full clear with a record Four Horsemen, one Sapphiron wipe that was lost in the first two Life Drain waves
overview: 15 of 15 bosses in 2h22m, about 10 minutes over the guild's usual Naxx night (median 2h11m). Most of that is the Sapphiron wipe (4:05 plus the run back) and a slow Sapphiron kill.

Fourteen bosses went down first try. The Four Horsemen kill (3:54) is the fastest in the logs, and Thaddius, Faerlina and Grobbulus were all well above the guild's usual standard on their key mechanics.

wipes.title: Sapphiron, pull 1 (wiped at 40%)
wipes.whatHappened: Life Drain lands on about 10 people every 20 to 25 seconds. In the first two waves (0:13 and 0:35) half of them were never decursed and drained for their full duration. Deaths started at 0:40: a healer, then a tank at 0:49 who got 110 healing in his last 10 seconds, then another healer at 0:57. By 1:45 ten people were dead, three of them healers. From the fifth wave on nearly every Life Drain was removed within a few seconds, but the raid never got the healing back and fell apart at 2:50 when the second tank went down (three Cleave deaths in one second).
wipes.likelyCause: The first two Life Drain waves. They cost early healer and tank deaths, and the healing they gave Sapphiron (297k over the pull, about a tenth of his health) is roughly what the raid was short when it wiped at 40%.
evidence: Life Drain waves 1 and 2: 10 of 20 never decursed. Waves 3 to 8: 11 of 59
Life Drain healed Sapphiron for 297k on the wipe vs 38k on the kill
On the wipe three players did 50 of the 58 Life Drain removals; on the kill five players shared all 79 (12 to 20 each)
7 deaths directly to Life Drain (a usual kill has about 1), and 4 of 5 tanks and 7 of 11 healers died
wipes.avoid: Have every decurser assigned and in range before the pull, so the first wave is cleaned up as fast as the later ones. The kill pull shows the raid can do it: all 79 removed, half of them within 2.7 seconds.

wentWell.text: Four Horsemen in 3:54, the fastest kill in the logs (previous best 4:12, guild median 5:13). Marks per raider were down to 12.6 from a usual 15.8.
Thaddius in 2:42 with only 6 wrong-side polarity hits. The guild usually takes around 28 there, and the median kill is 3:35.
Faerlina in 0:49 with 13 Rain of Fire hits, about a fifth of the usual 65 or so.
Grobbulus in 1:10 (median 1:25) with a median parse of 75, well up from the usual 60.
Kel'Thuzad down first try in 2:50. Every one of his 20 Frostbolt casts was interrupted, and there were only 2 Frost Blasts (usually about 29) and 5 mind controls (usually about 23).
27 raiders drank a shadow protection potion on Loatheb, about three times the usual 9, and nobody died.

notes.text: 0:48, a second faster than the previous best (median 0:58), on 43k raid DPS against a usual 38k.

Impale hit 29 raiders 34 times, about two thirds more per raider than usual, and the landings added another 20k of falling damage. Damage taken ran at 3.8k per second against a usual 2.6k. Spreading out of each other's lines would cost nothing.
0:49 with no deaths and only 13 Rain of Fire hits, about a fifth of the usual 65. Damage taken was 4.3k per second against a usual 5.9k.
Yulefuel handled all four Worshipper mind controls for her enrage, and raid DPS was 35k against a usual 30k.

At 0:35 Maexxna left her tank for the off tank, and the Poison Shock she cast while turning hit 24 raiders instead of the tank alone (53k, about six times a usual kill). The Web Spray at 0:40 then stunned everyone while she killed a mage and the off tank. No taunt was cast during the fight.

Birkler had her back for good from 0:50, and Vallon, Yulefuel and Mornie healed through the rest. Apart from that a normal kill: 1:09 against a median of 1:08, raid DPS on par, and the Web Wraps (6) and poison cleanses at the usual rate.
2:05 (median 2:13) with no deaths. Macharius soaked 44 of the 66 Hateful Strikes (242k) and Fenhir the other 22, while Birkler tanked 201k of melee.
Raid DPS 32k and healing right on the guild's usual numbers; Snotspat parsed 97.
1:10 against a median of 1:25 and a median parse of 75, well up from the usual 60. Raid DPS 32k against a usual 27k.
Only 3 poison cloud hits (usually about 10) and 2 Slime Sprays, so damage taken was a third below normal.
All 5 Frenzies were removed: Ulthras, Milshunter, Punintended and Speldosan landed two Tranquilizing Shots each, and the kill took 0:57 (median 1:06) on 29k raid DPS against a usual 25k.
Birkler took all but 10k of the melee, and nobody died.
2:42 against a median of 3:35, with only 6 wrong side polarity hits where the guild usually takes around 28. The median parse of 50 is well above the usual 37.
Chain Lightning was the biggest damage source (390k over 203 hits, normal for him). The one death, Eïnherjar at 1:59, came from Chain Lightning right after a polarity hit.
1:38 (median 1:46) with a median parse of 80 against the usual 70. Mornie and Yulefuel kept the Understudies under control.
Bruceli was hit directly by Razuvious and died to one Unbalancing Strike (6.6k) at 1:18, which usually means no Understudy held him for a moment, for example between taunts.
5:03, right on the guild median, and both Shadow Bolt Volleys from the Riders were interrupted.

Three deaths on the dead side: Bruceli to a Spectral Horse at 2:48, then Krits at 3:20 and Thornhild at 4:14 to Spectral Death Knights, mostly Whirlwind. Those Knights hit 19 raiders with Whirlwind for 87k in total.
3:54 is the fastest kill in the logs (previous best 4:12, median 5:13). Raid DPS was 9.1k against a usual 7.2k, and Marks per raider dropped to 12.6 from a usual 15.8.

Four players died at the same moment (1:50) to a Mark from the Spirit of Mograine. Spirits keep marking after the Horseman dies, so this is a group standing too close to the dead corner rather than a missed rotation. Lookdown died to a Void Zone at 2:18.
0:58 against a median of 1:09, with no deaths and 30k raid DPS (usually 26k). The 20 curses were removed and almost all damage was melee on the tanks.
1:13 with no deaths and no Eruption damage on anyone. 32 Decrepit Fevers were cured, 22 of them by Vallon and Mornie.
Spell Disruption hit 7 raiders for 16k.
27 raiders drank a shadow protection potion, about three times the usual 9, and nobody died. 2:50 against a median of 3:00.
Spores were taken by 25 people, slightly fewer per raider than usual (0.9 against 1.2), and the median parse of 37 is below the usual 46 even though raid DPS was normal.
The kill pull was clean on Life Drain: all 79 removed, half within 2.7 seconds, and no deaths to it.

It was slow (4:37 against a usual 3:53) because raid DPS was 76% of normal. The wipe had cost most world buffs: the raid had 77 Dire Maul buffs and 27 Sayge's buffs on the wipe and 4 and 1 on the kill. 22 people picked up Rallying Cry and Zandalar again in between.
The five deaths on the kill were all to Frost Aura or Blizzard, spread over the fight rather than in one chain.
On the wipe Birkler tanked Sapphiron for the full 4:05 and never died, even after 29 people around him had.

Down first try in 2:50. All 20 Frostbolt casts were interrupted, mostly by Lookdown (6), Bruceli (5) and Tochopolvo (4). Shadowtelia shackled 9 of the 15 Guardians, and there were only 2 Frost Blasts (usually about 29) and 5 mind controls (usually about 23).
Two deaths to Shadow Fissures (1:02 and 2:19), two to a Guardian of Icecrown at 2:15 and 2:30, which suggests one Guardian got loose briefly, and two to Frostbolt damage at 2:38.
Raid DPS was 88% of normal, likely the same lost world buffs as on Sapphiron.
